view: Intimate view into a roofless excavated Roman room at Herculaneum, faded red wall painting, charred wooden doorway fragments supported in masonry, patterned floor and deep volcanic deposit beyond, no restored palace or victims.

eras.title: A room preserved by the eruption
eras.caption: At Herculaneum, volcanic deposits preserved parts of upper floors, painted walls and even carbonised wood. Excavated rooms reveal details of domestic life that usually disappear when a building decays.
